title: Physics-Informed State Space Models for Day-Ahead Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.14014v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate day-ahead photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting requires both strong temporal modeling and adherence to physical PV system constraints. Purely data-driven models often ignore the underlying PV conversion process and may produce predictions that are outside the operational range of a PV system. In this paper, we propose a physics-informed state space framework that combines a differentiable PV conversion model with a selective state space backbone (PowerMamba). Our approach follows a physics-residual decomposition. The physics module provides a structured baseline based on solar geometry, irradiance, temperature effects, and inverter limits, while the state space model learns residual corrections from numerical weather prediction (NWP) inputs over a 24-hour horizon. Experiments on one year of utility-scale PV data show that the proposed method significantly improves forecasting accuracy, reducing RMSE by 38.5% and MAE by 45.8% co

translated_title: 面向日前光伏功率预测的物理信息状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 准确的日前光伏功率预测既需要强大的时间序列建模能力，又需要遵循光伏系统的物理约束。纯数据驱动的模型往往忽略底层的光伏转换过程，可能产生超出光伏系统实际运行范围的预测。本文提出了一种物理信息状态空间框架，将可微光伏转换模型与选择性状态空间主干网络相结合。我们的方法遵循物理-残差分解的思路：物理模块基于太阳几何、辐照度、温度效应和逆变器限制提供结构化基线，而状态空间模型则从数值天气预报（NWP）输入中学习24小时预测范围内的残差修正。在一年的公共事业规模光伏数据上的实验表明，所提出的方法显著提升了预测精度，RMSE降低了38.5%，MAE降低了45.8%。
tldr: 提出一种将可微光伏转换物理模型与PowerMamba状态空间网络相结合的物理-残差分解框架，使日前光伏功率预测的RMSE降低38.5%、MAE降低45.8%。
en_tdlr: A physics-informed framework combining a differentiable PV conversion model with the PowerMamba state space backbone uses physics-residual decomposition to reduce day-ahead PV power forecasting RMSE by 38.5% and MAE by 45.8%.
